stories.title: String of recent domestic violence-related deaths raise concerns for Minnesota advocates
stories.summary: Awareness advocates say this highlights longstanding patterns of violence against women and the need to address domestic abuse as a public health and safety issue.

stories.title: St. Paul city officials detail next phase in city's plan to address unsheltered homelessness
stories.summary: Assistant Mayor Cedrick Baker said St. Paul's two remaining camps, L'Orient and Randolph, will close Dec. 8 and Dec. 15, respectively.

stories.title: As Lake Superior and its watershed warms, scientists race to save native brook trout from disappearing
stories.summary: The Grand Portage Band of Lake Superior Chippewa is working to restore native trout populations.

stories.title: Woman charged with vehicular homicide after Brooklyn Center crash that killed 6-year-old
stories.summary: The 51-year-old woman reportedly didn't have a driver's license at the time of the crash.

stories.title: A small-town police dog earns a big award for getting so many drugs off the streets
stories.summary: Winthrop K9 Nash and his partner, Officer Nick Eickschen, earned the AKC's Humane Fund Awards for Canine Excellence.

stories.title: Mayor Frey vetoes Minneapolis City Council's data center ordinance
stories.summary: The Minneapolis City Council approved new regulations last week, including a requirement that potential data center projects be approved by the city council.

stories.title: 'Some people are going to really get hurt' | Crow Wing County seniors see Medicare costs soar, while options plummet
stories.summary: Crow Wing is one of three Minnesota counties where there are no Medicare Advantage or Medicare Cost plans available this year.

stories.title: Public utility commission to launch audit of Xcel Energy amid 'rapid rise' of errors and complaints
stories.summary: Xcel Energy said it's taking the issues seriously.

stories.title: Minneapolis Mayor vetoes city council's decision to deny Bill Peterson police chief job
stories.summary: Mayor Jacob Frey said Bill Peterson is the "right person at the right time to lead the MPD going forward."

stories.title: Jingle Bell Run to raise awareness about kids with arthritis
stories.summary: This year's 5k at U.S. Bank Stadium is set for Sunday, Nov. 22.

stories.title: Deadly motorcycle crash in Coon Rapids
stories.summary: Authorities said that once the officer determined the motorcyclist was speeding away, the officer "discontinued the traffic stop."

stories.title: Legal challenge to Nicole Mitchell's Woodbury City Council seat
stories.summary: Four voters in Woodbury argue that Mitchell's ongoing felony sentence disqualifies her from holding elected office.
